property_summary: After Initialized() is called (making intitalized true in the reference but not in the bug), then SetMinSum(1) is attempted — it reverts in the reference (intitalized already true) but succeeds in the bug (intitalized never set). The divergence is captured by a try/catch around SetMinSum.
change_summary: Remove the entire body of Initialized(), so it no longer sets intitalized to true.
